title.narrative: Improved humanitarian action for building disaster resilient communities

description.narrative: The project will improve the level of preparedness and response capacity of Oxfam, Partner and govt through real time response, training, knowledge sharing, coordination with relevant stakeholders, innovation & research and technical advisory support on the thematic areas (Water Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH), Emergency Food Security and Vulnerable Livelihoods (EFSVL), Cash Transfer Programme (CTP), Local Humanitarian leadership (LHL) & Partnership, Gender) to facilitate and improve the capacity for timely, appropriate and quality humanitarian response.
